problem: The live pricing page could render and pricing taps could respond while English switching still failed because the browser called /api/i18n-translate and Netlify returned 404.
root_cause: The i18n runtime and Netlify function both used the /api/i18n-translate contract, but netlify.toml did not explicitly route that public path to /.netlify/functions/i18n-translate. Previous browser gates rendered pages but did not execute the language action and probe the API. The critical delegated pricing rescue was also delivered as a separate asset; the exact preview proved that its ready marker could be absent even while the page rendered.
prevention: Netlify must explicitly route /api/i18n-translate to the i18n-translate function.
The critical pricing rescue is embedded inline in prijzen.html so tap handling cannot depend on a separate asset request.
Website CI must perform real mobile pricing taps and actual English switching on an exact Netlify preview with Functions.
The browser gate must probe the i18n endpoint before accepting the language flow.
Production closure requires the same interaction proof after merge.
